citation.authors: Kim MA, Jung YC, Bae J, et al

record.population: Laboratory test of sunscreen and facial makeup products
record.design: Laboratory study of sun protection factor (SPF) after layering products at typical consumer amounts
record.finding: At typical consumer amounts, which are lower than recommended, the SPF of each sunscreen and makeup product was dramatically lower than the label. Layering sunscreen with makeup greatly increased effective SPF compared with either alone, even at amounts below those recommended. The authors suggest layering may compensate for too little sunscreen.
record.note: Laboratory measurement, not people; skin tones not described in the abstract.
